title: V-Strom 650XT
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Suzuki V-Strom 650XT is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 85 HP and 70 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 195 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
